steps.say: I’m Titus—welcome. The site has an agent built in: me, and the whole website is a tool I can use. I’ll show you around.
Use Ask Titus to ask anything about my work, any time. If you’re hiring, paste a job description and I’ll honestly say how I fit.
I’m Lead AI Engineer at Mastercard; this pass opens my current role.
Each pass is one role: I’m picking up UOB and Illumina here, or you can see every role at once.
To find out more about my education, go here. I have a Master of IT in Business (AI track) from Singapore Management University.
My projects play like films. This one is fictional-bassoon, which I built on my own.
My writing is a newspaper of articles by year and theme; I can read them for you too.
Here’s a periodic table of every tool I’ve used, lighting up in the order I picked each one up.
Want to learn more about me, the copilot? Click here. This page shows how I’m built and tested.
That was a recorded run. Ask me anything now and watch me drive the site live.
